scripts.check: npm run format:check && uv run greenroom-context check && uv run python -m unittest discover -s tools/tests && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run openapi:check && npm run schema:check && npm test && npm run build
scripts.dev: npm run setup:local && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace @greenroom/api" "npm run dev --workspace @greenroom/web"
scripts.format: biome format --write . && uv run ruff format tools
scripts.format:check: biome format . && uv run ruff format --check tools
scripts.lint: biome lint . && node tools/check-errors.mjs && uv run ruff check tools
